## Source and method

- https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db
- https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/f00c92c7dcf1216a928a52c3706c7ce8e2f71ed5/dist/exercises.json
- https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/f00c92c7dcf1216a928a52c3706c7ce8e2f71ed5/LICENSE.md
- https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/f00c92c7dcf1216a928a52c3706c7ce8e2f71ed5/README.md
- https://github.com/wrkout/exercises.json/blob/5994bea047eee4d39a2c0872be3dd8fdd258ba31/LICENSE.md

Every exercise in free-exercise-db's dist/exercises.json, read from raw.githubusercontent.com on 2026-11-24 at commit f00c92c7dcf1216a928a52c3706c7ce8e2f71ed5 (git ls-remote HEAD), not at main, so a row and its image URLs keep pointing at the bytes read. Each image path is made absolute under exercises/ at that commit, as the README describes for main: "You can leverage github's hosting and access the single or combined [exercises.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/main/dist/exercises.json) and prefix any of image path's contained in the `JSON` with `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/main/exercises/` to get a hosted version of the image eg. [Air_Bike/0.jpg](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/main/exercises/Air_Bike/0.jpg) or leverage something like [imagekit.io](https://imagekit.io/) for dynamic image resizing which is utlized on the frontend [ example site ](https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/main/site/src/components/PhotoGallery.vue#L44-L54)" Lists are joined with "; ", and instruction steps with " | " (a line break inside a step becomes a space; no step contains "|"). healthkit, healthConnect and hcSegment are copied from this site's exercise taxonomy crosswalk (read 2026-11-05), never matched here: from its exercise-name row when the crosswalk matched the exercise's own name to a constant (crosswalkBasis "exercise-name"), otherwise from its category row when the exercise's category has the same name as a constant (crosswalkBasis "category"), otherwise empty (crosswalkBasis null). The crosswalk matches by normalized name only, never by meaning. 129 of 876 exercises carry a type; none carries a HealthKit type, because the crosswalk matched no free-exercise-db name or category to an HKWorkoutActivityType case.

## Fields

| Field | Description | JSON types | Null in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | free-exercise-db's id, which is also the name of its folder and JSON file | string | 0 of 876 rows |
| `name` | The exercise name as free-exercise-db spells it | string | 0 of 876 rows |
| `category` | strength, stretching, plyometrics, strongman, powerlifting, cardio or olympic weightlifting | string | 0 of 876 rows |
| `equipment` | The equipment as free-exercise-db names it; null where its file gives none | null, string | 77 of 876 rows |
| `level` | beginner, intermediate or expert | string | 0 of 876 rows |
| `mechanic` | compound or isolation; null where its file gives none | null, string | 87 of 876 rows |
| `force` | push, pull or static; null where its file gives none | null, string | 30 of 876 rows |
| `primaryMuscles` | Primary muscles, "; "-joined | string | 0 of 876 rows |
| `secondaryMuscles` | Secondary muscles, "; "-joined; null where it lists none | null, string | 272 of 876 rows |
| `steps` | DERIVED: the number of instruction steps | integer | 0 of 876 rows |
| `instructions` | The instruction steps, verbatim, " \| "-joined; null where it gives none | null, string | 5 of 876 rows |
| `imageCount` | DERIVED: the number of images | integer | 0 of 876 rows |
| `images` | The image URLs on raw.githubusercontent.com at the pinned commit, "; "-joined; null where it has none | null, string | 3 of 876 rows |
| `healthkitWorkoutType` | From the crosswalk: HKWorkoutActivityType cases with the same normalized name; null where it has none | null | 876 of 876 rows |
| `healthConnectExerciseType` | From the crosswalk: ExerciseSessionRecord.EXERCISE_TYPE_* constants with the same normalized name; null where it has none | null, string | 751 of 876 rows |
| `healthConnectSegmentType` | From the crosswalk: ExerciseSegment.EXERCISE_SEGMENT_TYPE_* constants with the same normalized name; null where it has none | null, string | 748 of 876 rows |
| `crosswalkBasis` | exercise-name when the crosswalk matched the exercise's own name, category when it matched its category, null when it matched neither | null, string | 747 of 876 rows |
| `source` | The exercise's JSON file on GitHub at the pinned commit | string | 0 of 876 rows |

A null means the source does not state the value or it could not be verified. It never means zero, and it is never a guess. In the CSV a null is an empty unquoted field.

## Update cadence

- `src/data/openExercises.ts` is generated by `scripts/fetch-open-exercises.mjs` from the sources above, last read 2026-11-24.
- No workflow runs that script: it is run by hand when the sources are re-read.
- The files are rebuilt by `npm run datasets` (scripts/build-datasets.mjs); a run with no source change writes byte-identical files. The edition stays 2026.1, and a new edition ships under a new file name rather than overwriting this one.
